# hermes-agent-squads

> Ready-to-install AI agent teams (squads) for Hermes Agent by Nous Research: a web squad
> that builds and publishes websites, a marketing squad, and a jobs squad that finds openings
> and writes applications. One command installs the builder bot; it installs the squads the
> user picks, suggests a model per bot, and creates new squads. MIT, no coding needed.

Installing for a user: install only the builder (AGENTS.md -> Installing for a user); squads and models are the user's choice.

Rules for agents: read AGENTS.md first. Verified Hermes behavior lives in
skills/hermes-platform/references/ (every fact cites a docs path under website/docs or a
source file). Never invent CLI flags: run `--help`. Model ids appear only in
scripts/data/model-roles.yaml and local/installed.yaml.
